# A broken column and its fallen drum (generated by make_env.py). Origin on the floor at the column.
new
material new Column --base-color 0.5608 0.5765 0.5373 --no-slot
material new Trim --base-color 0.3216 0.3255 0.2980 --no-slot
material new Moss --base-color 0.3647 0.4627 0.2627 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Plinth --size 1 --location 0.000 -0.000 0.250
scale 1.500 1.500 0.500
apply --scale
material assign Trim
active Plinth
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.5"
delete face
mode object
add mesh cylinder --name Shaft --vertices 8 --radius 0.550 --depth 2.800 --location 0.000 0.000 1.900
set rotation 0 0 22.5
apply --rotation
material assign Column
active Shaft
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete face
mode object
active Shaft
mode edit
select vert where "pos.z > 1.3 && pos.x > 0.1"
translate 0 0 -0.55
mode object
add mesh cone --name MossRing --vertices 8 --radius1 0.680 --radius2 0.580 --depth 0.160 --location 0.000 0.000 0.580
set rotation 0 0 22.5
apply --rotation
material assign Moss
active MossRing
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete face
mode object
add mesh cylinder --name Drum --vertices 8 --radius 0.55 --depth 1.7 --location -1.000 -1.750 0.500
set rotation 90 0 22.5
apply --rotation
set rotation 0 0 80
apply --rotation
material assign Column
add mesh ico-sphere --name Chip0 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.3 --location -1.100 0.600 0.180
material assign Trim
add mesh ico-sphere --name Chip1 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.22 --location 0.200 -1.000 0.140
material assign Column
select all
shade flat
export broken.glb
